subject: FP-RFI-4 answered: policyVersion is required only when issueIds is not empty

body.reason: The field records which policy took the work; an open that takes no work has nothing to record.
body.answer: Your reading is right. policyVersion is required when issueIds has at least one entry, and ignored otherwise. The contract's description of the field will say so from 2026-10-02.
